game_title: Input Interpreter – Cinder Cone Camp Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Input Interpreter: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly. Each round, ash wraiths strike the cooling vent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trust value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the cooling vent from ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp: keep the trust meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: trust drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Input Interpreter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp.
